_comment: DRISHTI Stratus bucket layout (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 8). Buckets are created in Console -> Stratus (no CLI); this is the reviewed source of names/prefixes/lifecycle applied at enable time. All buckets are PRIVATE (no public access); transfers use short-expiry EXACT-object presigned URLs. Real bucket names are supplied to AppSail via the DRISHTI_STRATUS_*_BUCKET env keys.

buckets.lifecycle: quarantine objects auto-expire in 7 days if not promoted; available objects retained; rejected purged in 24h
buckets.notes: New uploads land in quarantine/ and are promoted to available/ only after size/type/hash + isolated malware scan pass. NO OCR/transcription/extraction (capability-not-used).

buckets.lifecycle: staging CSV/JSON expire in 3 days; ds:import job report CSVs retained 30 days
buckets.notes: Holds the CSVs consumed by `catalyst ds:import` (object_url) and the generated job report files.

buckets.lifecycle: generated reports retained; superseded versions kept (versioning) for audit
buckets.notes: SmartBrowz output lands here watermarked + hashed + versioned before a report.ready Signal.

integrity_contract: For every object, SHA-256 + size + MIME + object_key + version_id are recorded in the corresponding Data Store row (EvidenceObject / ImportBatch / Report). The bytes never flow through the API or logs.
